messages.finding.binding-conflict: {what} is registered {count} times; the last one wins: {where}
messages.finding.consumer-require-missing: {module} is required by {who} but no module here declares it — either they are broken, or their map predates a rename
messages.finding.dead-function.file-local: {fn} is file-local and nothing in its own file mentions it
messages.finding.dead-function.internal: {fn} is marked @internal and nothing in the tree calls it
messages.finding.dead-function.no-caller: {fn} has no caller anywhere in the tree
messages.finding.dead-readme-link: {file} links to '{target}' which does not exist
messages.finding.dead-see-target: {fn}: @see target '{target}' does not resolve to a known module or function
messages.finding.feature-module-missing: {file}:{line} names '{text}' as the module of '{feature}', but this tree has no such file or module
messages.finding.file-holds-many-modules: {file} holds {count} module identities the map cannot separate: {modules}
messages.finding.layer-violation: {from} requires {to}, but {from_layer} must not reach into {to_layer}{why}
messages.finding.orphaned-class-alias: {kind} {name} is declared in {file} and referenced by nothing in the tree
messages.finding.param-name-mismatch: {fn}: @param #{index} is documented as '{documented}' but the signature declares '{actual}' at that position
messages.finding.placeholder-readme-link: {file} links to '{target}', which starts with the placeholder ${var}: no Markdown viewer expands it
messages.finding.require-not-declared: requires "{module}" (line {line}), which no file in this tree declares
messages.finding.sibling-reference-missing: {file} references '{target}', which does not exist in the {repo} checkout
messages.finding.tag-file-unavailable: tag_files['{prefix}'] points at {dir}, which has no readable module_map.json — requires under '{prefix}' were not checked
messages.finding.tag-require-missing: {module} is required by {who} but {prefix}'s own map does not declare it — either that require is broken, or that map predates a rename
messages.finding.type-vs-class: {module}: local "{name}" annotated ---@type {type}, but {count} field(s) are assigned to it after its literal — LuaLS reports missing-fields/"fields cannot be injected" for this shape; use ---@class instead (---@class {module} : {type}, plus @see the type definition, if {type} should still be checked against it)
messages.finding.unreferenced-module: {module} is required by no other file in the tree
messages.finding.unused-require: {file}:{line} binds require('{module}') to '{alias}' and never uses it
messages.report.not-applicable: Not applicable: {check} on {count} node(s); no {needs} in {languages}
